spec.title: Setup: run JUnit #2646's landed DisplayNameGenerationTests at both revisions
spec.description: Setup for case M19 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief.md, no claims. In the setup checkouts under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/worktrees (M19-junit-framework-fix = 694efb6dbd8506d623d5c117d1df39f9260f72df, M19-junit-framework-parent = 882bf488e228b1f55ed3b636838825dec31ec20d; standalone depth-1 clones, because the build's versioning plugin reads git history with JGit), runs the upstream Gradle build through $O/scripts/M19-gradle.sh: Gradle 7.1-rc-2 (checked against services.gradle.org and the wrapper's distributionSha256Sum) on JDK 11, toolchain AdoptOpenJDK 16.0.1+9 (checked), --no-build-cache and --no-scan (nothing from or to ge.junit.org), one init script that adds the public repositories for a moved test-distribution plugin and a jcenter-only grgit-core (copied with checked SHA-1). It compiles the junit-jupiter-engine tests (Java, Kotlin, Groovy) and runs org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayNameGenerationTests with -Pretries=0: on the fix online then offline, on the parent its own copy offline, then the fix's test and its two new fixture classes transplanted onto the parent (expected to fail, or not to compile; the step says which). JUnit summaries to .../logs, checkouts restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: the fix's DisplayNameGenerationTests pass online and offline, the parent's own pass, the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE
